title: Realistic Food For No Reason
description: This datapack changes the textures of different foods to look more realistic and detailed. It doesn't change the functionality of the food—only its look. The foods stay the same in-game, but they look more realistic.
body:
**Realistic Food For No Reason** is a _small_ visual datapack that overhauls the textures of a few food items in Minecraft to better resemble detailed and realistic versions. **It doesn't alter how the food works**—just how it appears in your inventory and when in-hand. The aim is simple:_ to make your food appear new and slightly more real, just for the heck of it!_

Whether survival or creative, this datapack brings a touch of additional flavor to your game. It's ideal for gamers who like subtle visual enhancements without having to install complete resource packs or complex mods.
